title: Hurricane Claw Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Vemar Hurricane Claw Hi-Viz Yellow is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1390g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~88 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

introduction: Positioned in Vemar's Full Face lineup, the Hurricane Claw Hi-Viz Yellow brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Vemar Hurricane Claw Hi-Viz Yellow represents Vemar's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Vemar Hurricane Claw Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
